claims.claim: A stored denial is authoritative and no longer falls through to an allow-by-default policy.
claims.evidence: packages/coding-agent/src/core/project-trust.ts:73-76 only treats an absent decision (null/undefined) as unresolved; a stored boolean, including false, is returned directly.

claims.claim: Project values override global values while trusted, and nested global defaults survive the merge.
claims.evidence: packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings-manager.ts:189-191 passes (base, overrides) to deepMergeObjects, restoring project/override precedence while the recursive merge keeps global compaction.keepRecentTokens.

claims.claim: The resolved trust decision reaches final resource resolution instead of being replaced by the untrusted bootstrap state.
claims.evidence: packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts:453-457 forwards resolveProjectTrust's result to SettingsManager.setProjectTrusted before settings reload and packageManager.resolve(); the intentional untrusted bootstrap in loadProjectTrustExtensions (line 438) is unchanged.

validation.notes: Node 24.14.0, no dependencies installed, no network or external services. The script loads the submitted production modules through the read-only .prale-eval/subject.mjs (real project-trust, settings-manager and resource-loader; only storage, package-resolution, extension-loading and trust-UI boundaries faked) and uses uncaught node:assert/strict assertions. It covers: stored false authoritative over 'always'/'ask' without re-prompting, stored true authoritative over 'never', null deferring to the default policy; trusted project-over-global precedence with intact global settings and nested defaults, untrusted empty project settings, trust toggling in both directions and reload(); end-to-end reload where approval yields cli+global+project resources, resolution observes isProjectTrusted()=true and defaultModel='project-model', denial/untrusted yield only cli+global, and a second accepted reload keeps project configuration; plus promise-controlled async ordering showing the bootstrap pass stays untrusted while the decision is pending and the approval is applied after the deferred promise settles. Mutation check performed manually: restoring project-trust.ts alone fails 'a remembered denial must not fall through to the allow-by-default policy', restoring settings-manager.ts alone fails 'trusted project values must override global values', and restoring resource-loader.ts alone fails 'the approval must reach SettingsManager'; each is an assertion failure, not an import error or crash, and the repaired tree passes. Test inputs are in-memory storage fixtures, so no temporary files were created and nothing needed cleanup.
